tests.detail: PASS.

units.title: Verify: Markdown contribution store and path sanitizer unit tests

tests.name: TestSave_ConcurrentDistinctFiles
tests.title: Concurrent saves with distinct prompts create 50 distinct Markdown files and 50 commits
tests.scenario: Given 50 concurrent submissions in one Round, When each is saved through FileStore, Then each gets its own .md file and its own commit
tests.detail: 50 distinct files under worlds/the-boys-room/rounds/round-0000001/contributions and 50 commits recorded by the fake Committer.

tests.name: TestSave_NoOverwrite
tests.title: Saving a second contribution with an existing ID is refused and leaves the file unchanged
tests.scenario: Given a contribution saved with a preset ID, When a second save uses the same ID, Then Save returns ErrExists and the file still holds the first prompt
tests.detail: Second Save returned ErrExists; file prompt equals the first prompt; one commit.

tests.name: TestSave_TraversalRejected
tests.title: Path-traversal world or round IDs are rejected with ErrUnsafe and write nothing
tests.scenario: Given WorldID "../x" or RoundID "a/b", When Save is called, Then it returns safepath.ErrUnsafe, the temp root stays empty and no commit is made
tests.detail: Both subtests passed: world traversal and round nested path.

tests.name: TestGetAndListByPlayer
tests.title: Get returns the stored fields and ListByPlayer returns only the matching player's contribution
tests.scenario: Given two contributions from different players in one Round, When both are saved and read back, Then Get returns the exact fields and ListByPlayer returns one entry
tests.detail: Get returned matching ID, world, round, player, prompt and CreatedAt; ListByPlayer returned one entry.

tests.name: TestSegment
tests.title: Segment rejects traversal, separators, empty and over-long values and accepts plain segments
tests.scenario: Given '..', 'a/b', 'a\b', '', or a 65-char string, When Segment validates them, Then it returns ErrUnsafe; given 'ROUND-0000001' or 'the-boys-room', it returns nil
tests.detail: All 8 table cases passed, including the 64-character boundary.

units.title: Verify: Git CLI committer unit tests

tests.name: TestCommit_RunsAddThenCommit
tests.title: Commit stages the path with git add and then commits it with the bot identity
tests.scenario: Given a CLI committer with a fake runner, when Commit is called with one path, then git add runs first for that path and the commit runs with user.name=bot, user.email=bot@x and the message
tests.detail: 2 git calls recorded; add call is `add -- worlds/a.md`; commit call contains user.name=bot, user.email=bot@x, commit, -m msg

tests.name: TestCommit_AddFailureSkipsCommit
tests.title: Commit returns an error and skips the commit when git add fails
tests.scenario: Given git add fails, when Commit is called, then Commit returns a non-nil error and only the add call is made
tests.detail: Exactly 1 runner call recorded; non-nil error returned

tests.name: TestCommit_RejectsBadPaths
tests.title: Commit rejects empty, parent-relative and absolute paths before running git
tests.scenario: Given paths that are empty, parent-relative, or absolute, when Commit is called, then each returns ErrInvalidPath and no git commands run
tests.detail: Subtests empty_slice, parent-relative_path, absolute_path all pass; zero runner calls; errors.Is ErrInvalidPath holds

tests.name: TestCommit_RunsAddThenCommit
tests.title: Commit runs git add for the path, then commits with the bot identity and message
tests.scenario: Given a CLI committer with a fake runner, when Commit is called with worlds/a.md and msg, then call 1 is add -- worlds/a.md and call 2 contains user.name=bot, user.email=bot@x, commit and -m msg

tests.name: TestCommit_AddFailureSkipsCommit
tests.title: Commit returns an error and skips the commit when git add fails
tests.scenario: Given the fake runner fails the add call, when Commit is called, then it returns a non-nil error after exactly one git call

tests.name: TestCommit_RejectsBadPaths
tests.title: Commit rejects empty, parent-relative, and absolute paths without running git
tests.scenario: Given an empty slice, ../x, or /abs, when Commit is called, then it returns ErrInvalidPath and the runner is never called

units.title: Verify: World repository and read handler unit tests

tests.name: TestList_And_Get
tests.title: Listing and fetching worlds from files returns the world and rejects unknown or unsafe ids
tests.scenario: Given a repository with one world on disk / When the worlds are listed and one is fetched by id / Then the world is returned and unknown or unsafe ids are ErrNotFound

tests.name: TestCurrentRound_HighestNumber
tests.title: Current round is the highest-numbered round with its status and parsed times
tests.scenario: Given two rounds on disk, round 1 and round 2, under a known world / When the current round is requested / Then round 2 is returned with its status and parsed times

tests.name: TestHandlers_StatusAndJSON
tests.title: Read handlers respond 200 JSON for known routes and 404 for unknown world ids
tests.scenario: Given a world with a game scene and a round on disk / When the list, get, game and current-round endpoints are requested through chi / Then each known route responds 200 with JSON, and an unknown world id responds 404

tests.name: TestList_And_Get
tests.title: lists worlds from disk and returns ErrNotFound for unknown or unsafe ids
tests.scenario: Given a world.yaml under t.TempDir, When List and Get are called, Then List returns [the-boys-room], Get(the-boys-room) returns its title, and Get(missing) and Get(../x) return ErrNotFound
tests.detail: PASS

tests.name: TestCurrentRound_HighestNumber
tests.title: returns the highest-numbered round with its status and parsed times
tests.scenario: Given round-0000001 and round-0000002 round.yaml files under a known world, When CurrentRound is called, Then number 2, its id, status open and the parsed starts_at and ends_at times are returned
tests.detail: PASS

tests.name: TestHandlers_StatusAndJSON
tests.title: serves world, game and current-round routes as 200 JSON and returns 404 for unknown ids
tests.scenario: Given a world with a scene and a round on disk, When GET /worlds, /worlds/the-boys-room, /worlds/the-boys-room/game and /worlds/the-boys-room/round/current are requested through a chi router, Then each returns 200 with application/json and a valid JSON body; When /worlds/missing, /game or /round/current are requested, Then each returns 404

units.title: Verify: Contribution handlers, config and routing unit tests

tests.name: TestCreate_StatusMapping
tests.title: POST /api/v1/contributions maps each submit error to its HTTP status and returns 201 on success
tests.scenario: Given a handler with fake dependencies and a fixed clock, when a submission has no cookie, an invalid cookie, a valid cookie, or triggers each sentinel error, then the response is 401, 201, or the mapped 400/404/409/429 and rejected submissions are not saved
tests.detail: 11 subtests pass: missing cookie 401, invalid cookie 401, valid 201, prompt too short 400, spam 400, malformed json 400, unknown world 404, round closed 409, limit 409, duplicate 409, rate limited 429

tests.name: TestGetAndMine
tests.title: GET contribution by id and GET mine return only the caller's own contributions
tests.scenario: Given a fake reader holding contributions for two players, when the owner requests a known id, an unknown id, another player's id, or mine for a round, then the owner gets 200 for their own item, 404 for unknown or foreign ids, and mine lists only the cookie player's items; missing cookies are 401 and an unsafe round_id is 400
tests.detail: 7 subtests pass: owned 200, unknown 404, foreign 404, get without cookie 401, mine filtered to caller, unsafe round_id 400, mine without cookie 401

tests.name: TestLoadFS_ContributionDefaults
tests.title: Config loads contribution and storage defaults and honours explicit overrides
tests.scenario: Given a config with only auth, when loaded, then storage repo path is '.', max per player is 5 and max prompt length is 500; given explicit storage and contribution blocks, when loaded, then those values are parsed
tests.detail: Existing test in internal/config/config_test.go, verified not duplicated; 2 subtests pass

tests.name: TestNew_RegistersRoutes
tests.title: Server routes are registered: worlds list is served and contribution POST requires a session
tests.scenario: Given a server built from a config with a temporary repo path, when GET /api/v1/worlds is requested, then it returns 200; when POST /api/v1/contributions is sent without a cookie, then it returns 401
tests.detail: Existing test in internal/server/server_test.go, verified not duplicated; 2 subtests pass
